The foot is our first point of contact with the ground during running, yet it’s often one of the most overlooked areas in strength training. We prioritize the quads, hamstrings, glutes and calves, but forget about the structures responsible for managing load, adapting to the ground and contributing to force transfer with every stride. Footwear can certainly assist with some of these demands, but passive support isn’t a substitute for developing active strength and control. It’s why I choose shoes like the altrarunning Vanish Pulse for faster runs. Zero drop. Room for natural toe splay. A lower-profile design. That way I can develop the capacity of my feet, rather than only relying on what surrounds them. 🫱🏽‍🫲🏾
